issues.description: Hydration mismatch: server renders 'Which room are we designing?' but client renders 'Style Quiz' in the header subtitle. This causes full root hydration failure and client-side re-render.
issues.element: Header subtitle text in step-3 page
issues.root_cause: In apps/web/app/design/step-3/page.tsx, the header subtitle uses dynamic/conditional text that differs between server and client render — likely reading from state, context, or localStorage that isn't available on the server, causing SSR/CSR mismatch.

issues.description: Wrong content displayed: step-3 should show image comparison pairs (two room images side by side) per expected behavior, but instead shows text-only questions ('How do you prefer your surfaces?') which belongs to a different step.
issues.root_cause: The step-3 page component is rendering text-choice questions instead of image comparison pairs. The question index or quiz data source may be misaligned, or the component is reusing the wrong question set.

issues.description: Multiple hydration errors reported (7x 'Text content does not match server-rendered HTML') causing entire root to switch to client rendering, degrading performance and UX.
issues.element: Multiple text nodes across the page
issues.root_cause: The page uses client-side state to determine displayed text (quiz step label, question text, progress) without suppressing hydration or using 'use client' with proper initial state matching SSR output.

fixes.reason: Track client mount state to avoid SSR/CSR mismatch by deferring dynamic content until after hydration.

fixes.old_str: Style Quiz
fixes.new_str: Style Quiz
fixes.reason: Add suppressHydrationWarning to the subtitle element that mismatches between server ('Which room are we designing?') and client ('Style Quiz') to prevent hydration errors while the root cause is investigated.

Confirm 'use client' directive is present and first — if the file was missing this, SSR would render with different context. This also documents intent. If the directive is already present this is a no-op comment addition.
